baseline_evaluation.dev_runtime_absence_scope: Dev target Cloud Run resources absence inspected per ODP-GCP-STAGING-EXECUTION-PREFLIGHT-003 receipts and RELEASE_MANIFEST.json initial_release_recovery section.
baseline_evaluation.baseline_search_scope: Search across repository tags, RELEASE_GATE_REGISTRY.json, and RELEASE_MANIFEST.json; no prior approved release manifest or immutable contract baseline exists for candidate C on dev.
baseline_evaluation.cross_environment_history_claim: unknown; absence of dev Cloud Run services is strictly scoped to dev runtime and does not imply historical absence across staging or prod, nor does it prove previous contract releases never existed. Cross-release backward compatibility cannot be attested without an immutable baseline and remains unknown/blocked.
baseline_evaluation.reasoning: Candidate C is targeted for dev release. Dev environment currently operates under initial-release recovery posture (delete-candidate-zero-traffic). Because no prior approved contract baseline or manifest exists in registry, cross-version breaking change diffs cannot be attested. Diffing against C itself is prohibited; diffing against moving origin/dev is prohibited. Gate 1 remains fail-closed blocked.
